evidence: validate_extraction_review_state.py requires each evidence file to equal the canonical raw '<sha>\t<ref>\n' ls-remote line; when the remote tip does not move, two captures are intentionally byte-identical.
The validator distinguishes captures through contiguous receipt mappings and strictly increasing RFC3339 confirmed_at values in closeout.json, not by altering the remote's canonical output.
Requiring different blob hashes for an unchanged remote would force non-canonical evidence and would be rejected by the repository validator.
